metadata.audit_scope: Independent Dual-Review Quality Control and Inter-Annotator Reliability

dataset_a_representative_qc_queue_status.integrity_enforcement_note: Agreement metrics for the 100-pair representative QC queue cannot be computed prior to genuine human second-review submissions. Under strict empirical guidelines, agreement scores are never simulated or fabricated.

dataset_c_empirical_qc_analysis.sample_size_limitation_analysis: With N = 20 dual reviews, the standard error is relatively large (SE = 0.1597), yielding a wide 95% confidence interval [0.3870, 1.0000]. While the point estimate (kappa = 0.7000) indicates substantial agreement, full statistical power requires completing the 100-pair representative QC queue, which will narrow the standard error to ~0.07.

blind_review_isolation_guarantees.isolation_mechanism: Secondary reviewer CLI hides primary labels, confidences, and rationale notes.
blind_review_isolation_guarantees.dispute_escalation: Discordant pairs are automatically routed to senior adjudication.
blind_review_isolation_guarantees.audit_trail_logging: All independent actions, timestamps, and confidence ratings are permanently logged in audit_trail.csv.
